create.name: All Beings Zen Sangha
create.bio:
All Beings Zen Sangha is a small Soto Zen community in Washington, DC, started in 2004 by a handful of Zen students and now serving practitioners across the District, Maryland and Virginia. It belongs to the lineage of Shunryu Suzuki and is one of the Branching Streams sanghas affiliated with San Francisco Zen Center. Dairyu Michael Wenger, a San Francisco priest based at Dragon's Leap Temple, gave the group its name and has supported it from the start. Its resident priest and abiding teacher is Rev. Inryu Bobbi Ponce-Barger, who took lay vows in 2005, was ordained as a priest in 2013 and received Dharma transmission from Wenger in 2017.

The sangha sits in a modest urban zendo in Adams Morgan, a short walk from Woodley Park, and every session is also open on Zoom. Early zazen with a short service runs on Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings, and a fuller Thursday evening programme adds walking meditation, chanting and, often, a talk. Newcomers need no experience, there are no fees, and the group keeps going on donations. Individual practice meetings with the teacher, sesshin and occasional retreats round out its life, and recordings of the teacher's talks are kept on its website.

courses.title: Weekly zazen (in person and on Zoom)
courses.description: Forty minutes of seated meditation with a brief service on Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings, and a longer Thursday evening session with walking meditation and chanting. Join at the Adams Morgan zendo or online.
courses.price: There are no fees for meditation sessions, workshops or retreats (dāna welcome)

courses.title: Dokusan: practice meetings with the resident teacher
courses.description: Short one-to-one meetings with Rev. Inryu Ponce-Barger to talk through your meditation and how it meets daily life, offered during weekly zazen, at retreats or by phone on request. The page explains the forms and what to expect.
courses.price: There are no fees for meditation sessions, workshops or retreats (dāna welcome)

free_resources.title: Inryū Sensei's Dharma Talks
free_resources.description: An archive of video and audio recordings of talks by the sangha's teacher from 2021 onwards, on themes such as the Sandokai, the ox-herding pictures, death poems and practice during Rohatsu sesshin.

free_resources.title: Loving Kindness Meditation
free_resources.description: The full text of the loving-kindness chant the sangha recites, wishing safety and happiness to every kind of being, near or far, seen or unseen.
